summary: Chrome Extension v8 Price/Color Extraction Testing Complete - 25/25 pattern tests passed. Identified 3 bugs causing the $99,999 price issue and color extraction problems.

code_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: 'Price Range' context not handled - causes $99 to be picked up from 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999' instead of actual trade price $649
Pattern \d{2} only matches 2-digit SKUs, fails for 4-digit SKUs like MOY-2302
code_bugs.suggested_fix: Change to ([A-Z]{2,}-\d+) to match any number of digits

code_bugs.issue: Pattern ([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z0-9]+) is too broad - matches common words like 'Product', 'The', 'SKU'

passed_tests: Price rejection: Prices over $50,000 correctly rejected
MSRP/MAP context detection: Prices near MAP/MSRP keywords correctly skipped
Labeled trade price patterns: Trade/Wholesale/Your/Net/Dealer Price patterns work
Loloi SKU from URL: /products/loe-03-natural-e -> LOE-03
Loloi color from H1: 'LOE-03 NATURAL / ESPRESSO' -> 'NATURAL / ESPRESSO'
Loloi MAP extraction: '$1,589 MAP' -> MSRP $1,589
Loloi rug dimensions: 8'6" x 11'6" pattern works
Four Hands SKU from URL: /product/100074-009 -> 100074-009
Four Hands price logic: Trade $500 correctly extracted, MAP $1,099 identified
Four Hands color bullet pattern: 'Durango Smoke • 100074-009' -> 'Durango Smoke'
Four Hands dimensions: 24.00"w x 27.50"d x 37.25"h pattern works
Uttermost SKU from page: 'SKU: 53083' -> 53083
Uttermost SKU from URL: /lenoir-swivel-chair-53083 -> 53083
Uttermost price patterns: Your Price/Trade/Net patterns work
Uttermost color from H1: 'Conifer Dining Armchair, Camel' -> 'Camel'
Uttermost dimensions: '34 W X 29 H X 30 D (in)' pattern works
Color extraction from labeled text: Color/Finish/Colorway patterns work

action_items: CRITICAL FIX: Add 'range' to skip context pattern at line 874 to prevent $99 from 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999' being picked up
MEDIUM FIX: Change Loloi SKU pattern at line 1273 from \d{2} to \d+ to match 4-digit SKUs
HIGH FIX: Change Crestview SKU pattern at lines 1170-1171 to use vendor-specific prefix CV
critical_code_review_comments: ROOT CAUSE of $99,999 bug: The extractTradePrice() function at line 874 doesn't skip prices in 'Price Range' context. When Loloi page has 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999', the $99 gets picked up as trade price instead of the actual $649.

The Loloi-specific code (lines 1296-1323) relies on DOM selectors (Add to Cart button, price elements) which may not always find the price, causing fallback to generic extractTradePrice() which has the bug.
Four Hands price logic (lines 1012-1036) correctly handles MAP prices by checking surrounding context.
Uttermost color extraction (lines 1127-1132) correctly extracts color from H1 title pattern 'Product Name, Color'.
The $50,000 price limit (line 862) correctly rejects $99,999 but doesn't prevent $99 from being picked up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chrome Extension v8 price/color extraction testing complete. All 25 regex pattern tests pass. CRITICAL BUG IDENTIFIED: The $99,999 bug is caused by 'Price Range' context not being handled in extractTradePrice() at line 874. When Loloi page shows 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999', the $99 gets picked up instead of $649. FIX: Add 'range' to the skip pattern. Also found 2 other bugs: Loloi SKU pattern only matches 2 digits, Crestview SKU pattern too broad.

bug_99999_price.symptom: Scraper returns $99,999 instead of $649 for Loloi rugs
bug_99999_price.root_cause: extractTradePrice() at line 874 doesn't skip prices in 'Price Range' context. The page has 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999' and $99 gets picked up as first reasonable price.
bug_99999_price.why_50k_limit_didnt_help: $99,999 is correctly rejected by the $50,000 limit, but $99 from 'Price Range: $99 - $99,999' passes through
